title: Specimen Collection Appointments: Patient Age, Guardian and Fasting Limits
content:
Each visit type of **Specimen Collection Appointments** serves patients within a published age range, requires a parent or legal guardian below a published age, and sets whether fasting tests may be collected and how late such a collection may start.

| Visit type | Youngest age served (whole years, on the appointment date) | Oldest age served (whole years) | Guardian required for patients younger than (years) | Fasting tests may be collected | Latest start for a collection with a fasting test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit | 5 | 120 | 18 | Yes | 10:00 |
| Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment | 5 | 120 | 18 | Yes | 10:00 |
| Fasting Priority Appointment | 12 | 120 | 18 | Yes | 09:30 |
| Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection | 12 | 120 | 18 | Yes | 10:00 |
| Pediatric Collection Appointment | 0 | 17 | 18 | Yes | 10:00 |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | 2 | 120 | 18 | Yes | 10:00 |
| Facility Bedside Collection Visit | 18 | 120 | 18 | Yes | 09:00 |

## How the limits read

- **Age range** — the youngest and oldest patient age, in whole years on the appointment date, that the visit type serves.
- **Guardian** — patients younger than the figure shown must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian; the figure is 18 for every visit type.
- **Latest fasting start** — the latest start time for a collection that includes a test needing fasting.

## Worked readings (hypothetical patients)

| Patient on the appointment date | Visit type | Within the age range? | Guardian needed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aged 17 | Pediatric Collection Appointment | Yes (0 to 17) | Yes (younger than 18) |
| Aged 18 | Pediatric Collection Appointment | No (oldest is 17) | — |
| Aged 11 | Fasting Priority Appointment | No (youngest is 12) | — |
| Aged 12 | Fasting Priority Appointment | Yes | Yes |
| Aged 1 | Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | No (youngest is 2) | — |
| Aged 18 | Facility Bedside Collection Visit | Yes | No |

A collection with a fasting test on a Facility Bedside Collection Visit starting at 09:00 is at the latest permitted start; at 09:15 it would be later than permitted.
